description: Build a one-page memo a Korean resident can bring to a tax, labor, accounting, court-filing, administrative, real-estate or financial-planning consultation: the situation, events in date order, the amount, the desired outcome, numbered questions, the papers already in hand and the papers still worth bringing for that field. Leave expert out to pick the field from the situation. Uses only the facts given; no legal or tax judgement.

expert.description: Field; leave out to guess from the situation

have.description: Papers already in hand (use the field's bring list wording)

situation.description: One or two lines on what happened

name: draft_kr_consult_memo
title: Draft Korea consult memo
